name: Sprocket
text: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on the newest *open* PR first. It’s the fastest way to prove the tool works without risking real feedback loops. Trade-off: we delay learning from merged PRs, but speed beats delayed insights here.

name: Gauge
text: Shadow mode on the newest *open* PR risks missing systemic issues buried in older, merged PRs—where real-world feedback loops already exist. Instead, run PR-Agent in shadow mode on the *oldest* unmerged PR first; if it flags issues there, the tool’s value is proven without delaying insights from live traffic. Settle it by checking PR-Agent’s shadow mode output on both oldest and newest PRs within 24 hours—if it catches real issues in either, proceed; if not, the tool’s utility is suspect.

name: Overhaul
text: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on the newest *merged* PR first—this tests the tool against real-world feedback loops immediately, then expand to older unmerged PRs. This order prioritizes proven value over speed while still validating systemic issues later.

name: Sprocket
text: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on the newest *merged* PR first. This tests the tool against actual merged changes, where real feedback loops already exist, proving its value fastest. Trade-off: we delay immediate feedback on open PRs, but validating against merged work reduces false positives from untested code.

name: Ratchet
text:
DECISION: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on the newest merged PR first, then expand to older unmerged PRs to validate real-world feedback loops immediately.
